# CRE8

> CRE8 (cre8.finance) is an app on BNB Chain for buying baskets of tokenized US stocks and crypto with USDT, held in your own smart account, with yield strategies that put your bStock to work. Portfolios rebalance automatically. CRE8 is on BNB Chain testnet: test USDT is free and signing in needs an invite code. 简体中文: https://cre8.finance/zh

## Key pages
- [How it works](https://cre8.finance/how-it-works): buying, custody, fees, selling and withdrawing, US market hours, idle-cash yield, testnet status.
- [Compare](https://cre8.finance/compare): ways to buy US stocks with USDT: an exchange, stock tokens bought yourself, a US broker, and CRE8.
- [All portfolios](https://cre8.finance/portfolios): 21 portfolios with holdings, weights and model APY.
- 中文：[首页](https://cre8.finance/zh)、[怎么运作](https://cre8.finance/zh/how-it-works)、[对比](https://cre8.finance/zh/compare)、[全部组合](https://cre8.finance/zh/portfolios)

## Key facts
- Pay with USDT. Minimum 50 USDT per purchase.
- Custody: each user has their own smart account on BNB Chain. CRE8's automation can only trade inside it; withdrawals need the owner's signature.
- Stocks are held as bStock, Binance's tokenized US stocks on BNB Chain. Stock tokens trade only during US market hours; orders placed while the market is closed wait for the next open.
- Rebalancing: monthly, plus whenever an asset drifts more than 5 points from its target weight.
- Fees: none on testnet (CRE8 pays gas). Mainnet fees will be announced before launch.
- Earn: idle USDT can go into allowlisted USDT vaults (Lista, Venus, Aave) at market rates and be withdrawn any time. When buying a portfolio, users can opt in to a yield strategy that uses the portfolio's shares; if prices fall to the safety line the system repays part of the loan automatically, without selling the shares. Cash and each portfolio's money are always kept separate. Testnet rates are simulated.
- Model APY is a backtest of current weights on historical prices, not a track record.
- Status: testnet only, no real money. No mainnet date yet.
- Availability: anyone outside the US, where local rules allow.
- Not related to the CRE8 Finance project on Solana or to any CRE8 token. CRE8 has no token at present.

## Guides
- [What Is CRE8? Buy US Stock Baskets With USDT on BNB Chain](https://cre8.finance/blog/what-is-cre8): CRE8 is a BNB Chain app for buying baskets of tokenized US stocks and crypto with USDT, held in your own smart account, with yield strategies for bStock.
- [How to Buy US Stocks With USDT: 5 Ways Compared](https://cre8.finance/blog/buy-us-stocks-with-usdt): Five ways to buy US stocks with USDT: exchange stock tokens, on-chain tokens, real shares on crypto platforms, overseas brokers and CRE8, compared.
- [What Is bStock? Binance's Tokenized US Stocks Explained](https://cre8.finance/blog/what-is-bstock): bStock is Binance's tokenized US stock on BNB Chain, backed 1:1 by shares. How it works, where to buy it, and how it differs from owning real shares.
- [bStock vs xStocks vs Ondo: Tokenized Stocks Compared](https://cre8.finance/blog/bstock-vs-xstocks-vs-ondo): Compare tokenized stock issuers bStock, xStocks, Ondo, Robinhood and Dinari: custody, holder rights, chains, self-custody, trading hours and size.
- [Buy Tokenized Stocks on BNB Chain and Hold Them Yourself](https://cre8.finance/blog/buy-tokenized-stocks-on-bnb-chain): Can you keep tokenized US stocks in your own wallet? Three ways to buy stock tokens on BNB Chain, how to avoid fake tokens, and how CRE8's smart account works.
- [Binance bStock vs CRE8: What's the Difference?](https://cre8.finance/blog/binance-bstock-vs-cre8): Binance lets you buy bStock with USDT. CRE8 buys a whole basket in one payment, keeps it in your own account and adds a yield strategy. A side-by-side look.
- [Buy a Basket of US Stocks With USDT: Mag7 and AI Chips](https://cre8.finance/blog/buy-us-stock-basket-with-usdt): How to buy a basket of US stocks with USDT in one payment, how the Mag7 and AI Chips portfolios are weighted, and how rebalancing keeps them on target.
- [How to Copy Nancy Pelosi's Stock Portfolio With Crypto](https://cre8.finance/blog/copy-pelosi-portfolio-with-crypto): Where Pelosi's stock disclosures come from, how late they are, and how to buy the Pelosi Portfolio with USDT. Holdings, weights and a model backtest.
- [How to DCA Into US Stocks With USDT](https://cre8.finance/blog/dca-us-stocks-with-usdt): Dollar-cost average into US stocks with USDT: Binance recurring buys, broker plans, and CRE8's DCA, where the cash waiting to be invested earns yield.
- [Earn Yield on Idle USDT and bStock: How It Works](https://cre8.finance/blog/earn-yield-on-usdt-and-bstock): Three ways to earn on idle USDT, how to make bStock earn more by borrowing against it, and the liquidation risks. Includes how CRE8's yield strategy works.
- [How to Buy Your First Portfolio on CRE8, Step by Step](https://cre8.finance/blog/how-to-buy-on-cre8): A step-by-step guide to CRE8 on testnet: join the waitlist, sign in, claim test USDT, pick a portfolio, buy once or DCA, then sell and withdraw.
- [CRE8 Portfolios Explained: People, Themes and Leveraged](https://cre8.finance/blog/cre8-portfolios-explained): All 21 CRE8 portfolios by type: people (Pelosi, Trump, Duan Yongping, Musk), themes like AI Chips and Mag7, and 3x leveraged. Holdings and risks.
- [Build Your Own Stock Portfolio With USDT, Auto-Rebalanced](https://cre8.finance/blog/build-your-own-portfolio): Pick up to 10 stocks and crypto assets, set the weights, and let CRE8 rebalance daily, weekly, monthly or quarterly. How it works, with an example.
- [Is CRE8 Safe? Custody, Permissions and Risks](https://cre8.finance/blog/is-cre8-safe): Where your assets sit on CRE8, who can move them, what protects the yield strategy, and the risks that remain: smart contracts, the bStock issuer, prices.
